fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`is_tournament_channel()` in `discordbot/commands/explain.py` only checked a single `tournament_channel_id`. When users in the #throwbacks Discord channel ran `/explain reporting`, they received the league reporting instructions instead of the Gatherling tournament instructions.

## What changed

- Added `throwback_channel_id` configuration key to `shared/configuration.py` (defaults to `'0'`, meaning unconfigured) so the team can set it to the real throwback channel's Discord ID without a code change.
- Updated `is_tournament_channel()` to check whether the channel ID matches any configured tournament-style channel (both `tournament_channel_id` and `throwback_channel_id`), skipping any that are zero/unconfigured.

## How to activate

Set `throwback_channel_id` in `config.json` (or via the normal configuration mechanism) to the Discord ID of the #throwbacks channel. Until then the default of `0` is falsy and the function behaves exactly as before.

## Validation

`uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` passed on both touched files. Unit tests could not run due to the database being unavailable in the sweep environment (all discordbot and shared tests require a live DB connection).

Fixes #11466
